summary.ja: Yee FDTDの真空・Fresnel界面・PMLと一次元の損失・Lorentz分散板を固定入力で検証。
summary.en: Fixed-input Yee FDTD checks for vacuum, Fresnel interfaces, PML and 1D lossy/Lorentz slabs.

references.label: Numerical solution of initial boundary value problems involving maxwell's equations in isotropic media (1966)
references.scope: Method-specific source; see the detailed reading for source role and actual review depth.

references.label: Fadime Bekmambetova and Xinyue Zhang and Piero Triverio (2017). A Dissipation Theory for Three-Dimensional FDTD with Application to Stability Analysis and Subgridding
references.scope: Research preprint v2; energy Eq26 and strict CFL Eq35 consulted. Not a claim to implement its subgridding method.

references.label: Jean-Pierre Bérenger (1994). A Perfectly Matched Layer for the Absorption of Electromagnetic Waves
references.scope: Original split-field PML publication: bibliographic identity and abstract checked. Original full text was not available for inspection. The implemented reduction and discrete balance are derived and tested separately; consult Johnson for the matched-layer interpretation.

references.label: Steven G. Johnson (2021). Notes on Perfectly Matched Layers (PMLs)
references.scope: Author notes, selected sections3.4,4.1–4.2 and7.1–7.3: independent x/y coordinate stretches and simultaneous corner damping, matching electric/magnetic rates, anisotropic interpretation, discretization reflections and incidence limitations. Not a complete audit of every PML formulation.

references.label: Markus Zahn (2003). Electromagnetic Field Theory: A Problem Solving Approach
references.scope: Author textbook, selected sections 7-6-1/7-6-2 (printed pp522–524), 7-9-1 (pp538–540), and 7-9-3/7-9-4 (pp541–544): normal/oblique Fresnel amplitudes, Snell and critical angles, evanescent fields, p-polarized Brewster condition and normal-power weighting. Field/sign conventions are adapted explicitly. Not an original Fresnel publication or a full-book audit. Selected sections 7-2-1 and 7-6-3 additionally consulted for conducting waves, complex wavenumber and conducting-interface context; the finite Lorentz slab and midpoint energy law are derived separately.

references.label: Meep developers (accessed 2026). Materials — official documentation
references.scope: Official HTML, selected Material Dispersion, Loss and Gain, and Conductivity and Complex ε sections: Lorentz polarization equation and exp(−iωt) convention. Meep uses a D-conductivity convention; this example instead uses conventional σE. Its explicit-ADE resonance stability bound is not attributed to our implicit midpoint update. No Meep numerical comparison or full documentation audit.

assumptions: New r6: linear isotropic passive nonmagnetic finite slabs in vacuum, 1D normal incidence, one Lorentz resonance or Ohmic conduction. Earlier TMz/TEz cases retained.
units: Dimensionless normalized length, time and fields.
boundary_conditions: New r6: distant PEC caps, no PML, aligned half-volume slab interfaces and vacuum monitors. Earlier periodic/PEC and PML examples retained.

next_deliverable.ja: 多共鳴・斜め分散界面と分散媒質PMLは別に検証。
next_deliverable.en: Separately validate multiple resonances, oblique dispersive interfaces and dispersive-media PML.

limitations.ja: 教育用Yee FDTD。真空・Fresnel界面・s/p偏光・PMLの既存例を保持し、第6版で一次元垂直入射のOhmic・受動Lorentz板を追加。帯域解析解、反射・透過・直接散逸・物質蓄積、修正離散収支・物理流束と格子・時間収束を分けて検査。一般分散、多共鳴、斜め分散入射、分散PML、一般2/3次元の包括的検証ではない。
limitations.en: Educational Yee FDTD: retained vacuum/Fresnel/s-p/PML examples plus r6 1D normal-incidence Ohmic and passive Lorentz slabs. Spectral references, R/T, direct dissipation, material storage, modified/physical budgets and space/time refinement are separate checks. Not blanket validation of general dispersion, multiple resonances, oblique dispersive incidence, dispersive PML or general 2D/3D.

metadata_review.level: Original educational Yee code: continuum slab/packet checks, direct dissipative work and oscillator storage, discrete/physical energy budgets, spatial/temporal refinement and independent ZIP reruns.

assumptions_ja: 第6版は線形・等方・受動・非磁性板、真空中の一次元垂直入射、単一Lorentz共鳴または導電損失。旧TMz/TEz例も保持。
units_ja: 無次元。長さ・時間・場を規格化。
boundary_conditions_ja: 第6版は遠方PEC外端、PMLなし、半体積平均の整合界面と真空モニター。旧周期/PEC・PML例を保持。
run_commands: python -m pytest -q test_fdtd.py test_scattering.py test_corner.py test_oblique.py test_polarization.py test_dispersive.py
run_from: Extracted Yee FDTD supplement directory (2D TMz/TEz; 1D loss/dispersion slabs)
